Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Vinod - 32 years, son
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
2. Neeta - 31 years, daughter
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Vikram - 29 years, friend
Look: glasses, brown sweater

Places

1. The village well - a stone well, a rope and a bucket

Scene 1: The village well - Day

[Vinod stands by the well. Neeta and Vikram stand near him.]

Vikram: "What lovely weather!"

[Vinod grinds wheat on the stone hand-mill.]

Neeta: "I'm ready!"

[Vinod churns butter in the earthen pot.]

Neeta (happily): "I really enjoyed today."
